question: 4 times the present age of P e×ceeds the present age of Q by 35 years. After 8 years, 2 times the age of Q will be 40 years less than 6 times the age of P. The present age of Q (in years) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **P** and **Q** be the present ages.

Equation 1: 4P − Q = 35 ⇒ Q = 4P − 35

Equation 2: 2(Q + 8) = 6(P + 8) − 40 ⇒ 2Q + 16 = 6P + 48 − 40 ⇒ 2Q = 6P − 8 ⇒ Q = 3P − 4

Equating Q: 4P − 35 = 3P − 4 ⇒ **P = 31 years**.

Put P in Q = 3(31) − 4 = 93 − 4 = 89 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 89 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8976f9d41ba10885bb61ae54af189de986065d17e3864b9d5adc12db70343226.png] 

Given:

⇒ 4 × **P** = **Q** + 35 —— (i)

⇒ 2 × (**Q** + 8) = 6 × (**P** + 8) − 40 —— (ii)

From (i): **Q** = 4P − 35

Substitute **Q** in (ii):

⇒ 2(4P − 35 + 8) = 6P + 48 − 40

⇒ 2(4P − 27) = 6P + 8

⇒ 8P − 54 = 6P + 8

⇒ 2P = 62

⇒ **P = 31 years**

Now, find **Q**:

⇒ **Q** = 4(31) − 35 = 124 − 35 = 89 years

**∴ The correct answer is 89 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations in Ages

Problems involving two variables are solved by forming two **simultaneous equations** based on past, present, or future conditions.

Age Ratio Constant

The **difference between ages** of two people remains constant regardless of the number of years passed or preceding.

Future and Past Ages

If present age is x, age after 'n' years is (x + n) and age 'n' years ago was (x − n).</p
